statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-120148 (PostgreSQL extended-statistics pseudo-type confusion executes arbitrary code) in 16.16 on the PostgreSQL 16 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-120148/ lists 16.16 as the fixed release for major version 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/30f67bdac5a0c8d038157addcdc31b293edf2844 on the REL_16_STABLE branch, which changes src/backend/catalog/heap.c, src/backend/commands/statscmds.c, src/backend/statistics/extended_stats.c, src/backend/statistics/mcv.c, src/backend/utils/adt/ruleutils.c and src/backend/utils/adt/selfuncs.c (plus regression tests) so that CREATE STATISTICS rejects expressions of a pseudo-type, and the planner, statistics readers and ANALYZE refuse such statistics objects that already exist; it is tagged Security: CVE-2026-120148 and is in the REL_16_16 release tag and not in REL_16_15. The commit message notes that statistics objects of this kind created on an earlier minor release can still exist after the upgrade and should be dropped; the fixed release raises an error when they are used rather than removing them. The DHI postgresql16 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes. We checked the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres, in every published postgresql16 package for Alpine 3.23 on both x86_64 and aarch64 (checksums verified against the package index): 16.16-r0 reports PostgreSQL 16.16 and carries the fix, while the earlier builds 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0 report 16.13, 16.14 and 16.15 and are affected. As a check, the postgres server binary contains the error messages this fix adds ("expression has pseudo-type %s", "cannot interpret statistics on an expression of pseudo-type %s" and "no collation was derived for expression with collatable type %s") in 16.16-r0 on both architectures, and the same file in 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0 does not. 16.16-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix. Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD lists CVE-2026-120148 under its 16.16-r0 secfixes.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-120148 (PostgreSQL extended-statistics pseudo-type confusion executes arbitrary code) in 18.7 for major version 18: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-120148/ lists 18.7 as the fixed release for 18, and the 18.7 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.7/, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/74a999de18d442a3fecf752dceff2144110e75c4 on the REL_18_STABLE branch, tagged Security: CVE-2026-120148 and Backpatch-through: 14, in the REL_18_7 release tag and not in REL_18_6. It changes src/backend/catalog/heap.c, src/backend/commands/statscmds.c, src/backend/statistics/extended_stats.c, src/backend/statistics/mcv.c, src/backend/utils/adt/ruleutils.c and src/backend/utils/adt/selfuncs.c so that pseudo-type expressions are rejected in extended statistics; its other changes are regression tests. The DHI postgresql18 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes, and it lists CVE-2026-120148 under its 18.7-r0 secfixes. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql18 at 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0. The vulnerable code is in the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql18/postgres, which the postgresql18 package ships in every one of those builds on both architectures. We checked every published postgresql18 package for Alpine 3.23 on both x86_64 and aarch64 (checksums verified against the package index): the postgres server binary in 18.7-r0 reports PostgreSQL 18.7, while the earlier builds 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0 and 18.6-r0 report 18.1, 18.2, 18.3, 18.4 and 18.6. The error messages the fix adds, expression has pseudo-type %s and cannot interpret statistics on an expression of pseudo-type %s, appear in the 18.7-r0 server binary and in no earlier build. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 18.7, so they are affected; 18.7-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-120148, type confusion in extended statistics that lets an object creator execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, in 17.12. Within major version 17, releases before 17.12 are affected. https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-120148/, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/. Debian fixed it for trixie in postgresql-17 17.12-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6625-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-120148. The postgres server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix, and 17.12-0 is the lowest published build that does. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0.
